sources.snippet: What is deit-tiny-patch16-224? DeiT-tiny is a data-efficient Vision Transformer (ViT) model designed for image classification tasks. Developed by Facebook Research, it represents a more efficient approach to training transformer models for computer vision. The model processes images as 16x16 pixel patches and operates at a 224x224 resolution.
